filters.vertical: Ellipsoidal external heights; no geoid conversion to CGVD28GVRD, so only relative tile offsets were inspected

interpretation: No independent samples were found in 4830E_54530N.
4840E_54520N had no usable independent ground sample after screening.
Two target tiles had sparse GEDI samples; relative offsets were about -1.6 m and -0.3 m against the inlier median.
The external sample does not resolve all four tiles and cannot support a local correction.
The full-sample +0.011 m correction and western-outlier caveat are retained.
